snapshots.session_notes: Pre-flight: David Atlija confirmed logged in as Genius Level 2 (visible top-right on booking.com homepage). Currency EUR confirmed throughout. HOTEL NAVIS: Genius Level 2 rewards sidebar visible — 15% discount applied on top of public Getaway Deal prices (28% off rack). All Navis rates carry Genius badge. May 15 2026 (Friday) is fully SOLD OUT at Navis — all room types show 'Not available on our site for your dates'; entry recorded with sold_out:true. May 23 (Saturday) only Superior Suite available for 2 adults (standard rooms sold out). Jun 10 only Deluxe room available for 2 adults. Jun 6 only Deluxe room available for 2 adults. HILTON COSTABELLA: No Genius discount sidebar shown — hotel does not participate in Genius discount programme. Prices shown are what David sees as logged-in Genius 2 member (same as public). URL from config worked correctly. All King Room with Balcony and Sea View. May 15 Hilton shows 'Total cost to cancel' on cheapest rate rather than free cancellation — recorded as refundable:false. BEVANDA: No Genius discount visible. Prices show 10% or 15% public Getaway Deal discounts on various dates. Small/Superior/Deluxe rooms vary by date availability. MILENIJ: Config URL 'milenij-opatija' returned 404 page-not-found. Hotel found via Booking.com homepage 'Looking for perfect stay' widget — actual URL slug is 'hotelmilenijopatija' (hotel now branded Amadria Park Hotel Milenij). URL correction noted. Genius badge visible on search listing but no Genius sidebar/discount shown on property page — rates are base rack with optional breakfast (€30 supplement). 'Free room upgrade applied' badge shown on most dates. Non-refundable rate (€179) shown for May 13 only; all other dates show free cancellation. AMBASADOR: URL from config worked correctly (ambasador). No Genius discount shown. Mix of non-refundable and Getaway Deal rates. Jul 29 shows refundable rate as cheapest (no non-refundable option available). All prices directly observed on Booking.com pages during this session — zero fabricated, interpolated, or inferred values.
